content: MCPB (.mcpb, ex-DXT): ZIP with manifest.json; spec now under modelcontextprotocol/mcpb, current manifest spec ~0.4 with 0.1/0.2 accepted for backward compat; Node bundles must vendor node_modules inside the archive (no install step at load time); user_config entries with sensitive:true go to OS keychain and are injected via ${user_config.key} into env — this injection works in Claude Desktop but has silent-failure reports on other load paths; use mcpb CLI (pack/validate) rather than hand-zipping; dev deps and junk inflate bundle size unless ignored.
